results.name: Sega Mega Drive Collection ROM, (NSP/XCI)
results.description:
## 🎮 [Sega Mega Drive Collection Download](https://ehoron.net/)

Sega Mega Drive Collection ROM, (NSP/XCI) delivers a classic retro gaming experience on Nintendo Switch, combining a variety of arcade-style action, platforming, racing, fighting, and adventure games. Players can enjoy a collection of iconic titles, revisit classic gameplay, and experience different challenges across multiple genres. With its nostalgic presentation, simple controls, and timeless gameplay, Sega Mega Drive Collection offers an entertaining experience for Nintendo Switch players who enjoy classic and retro games.

Sega Mega Drive Collection lets players switch between different games, explore classic levels, battle enemies, race through tracks, and take on challenging stages. Use quick reactions, precise controls, and classic gaming skills to overcome challenges, complete levels, and experience a nostalgic retro gaming adventure on Nintendo Switch.

results.name: Ristar
results.description:
The titular protagonist of SEGA's *Ristar* for the SEGA Genesis/Mega Drive. This model is an extensive edit of Ristar's model from his cameo appearance in *Sonic and SEGA All-Stars Racing*.
The model is fully rigged and has optional meshes for his eyelids and for flipping the direction of his mouth. The overall design is meant to be similar to how Sonic models tend to be designed in games like *Sonic Generations*.
Feel free to use this however you like!

results.name: Kaiser Greedy
results.description:
The main antagonist of *Ristar*, a game created by SEGA and Sonic Team near the end of the lifespan of the SEGA Genesis/Mega Drive. Also included are some of his minions, the Orblets. Each model is rigged, though Greedy's eyes are meant to be controlled using UV editing.

Feel free to use these models however you like!

results.name: XE-1ST2
results.description: The XE-1 ST2 is a joystick manufactured by Dempa. It is an upgraded version of the XE-1 ST, designed for use with multiple platforms, namely all Sega home consoles from the SG-1000 II to the Mega Drive (the XE-1 ST only supported up to the Master System), as well as any PC that uses DE-9 ports for game controllers (such as the MSX family, FM-TOWNS, X68000 and certain PC-88 models).
